title: SSE parser: multi-line data field drops earlier lines
description:
parse_sse_event loops over event lines but overwrites the 'data' variable on each "data:" prefix match (line 133). Per RFC 6297 (EventSource spec §2.2), if a message contains multiple "data:" lines, they should be concatenated with \n between them. Currently only the last "data:" line is used; earlier lines are lost.

Wire format example:
  event: state
  data: {"changed":
  data: {"a-self":{"Message":"s-42"}}}

Current behavior: Only the second line is parsed.
Expected behavior: Both lines are concatenated and parsed as complete JSON.

Impact: Low (kithd never sends multi-line data), but violates SSE spec compliance.
